inconsistencies.topic: Autofocus is off in React/JSX but on in Astro and Svelte
inconsistencies.detail: jsx-a11y/no-autofocus (ESLint react, Oxlint react) and Biome noAutofocus are off, but the ESLint astro preset reports astro/jsx-a11y/no-autofocus at error and the ESLint svelte preset reports Svelte's a11y_autofocus through svelte/valid-compile (both measured with lintText). Neither was a recorded decision; both come from 'every non-deprecated rule' and became live on 2026-09-28 (d6ee272c, 9ae95d16).

inconsistencies.topic: Label options exist only in ESLint
inconsistencies.detail: ESLint label-has-associated-control checks Label/Input/Select/Textarea/Checkbox/Radio at depth 3 (7a6aa5fc); Oxlint (same option names supported, defaults labelComponents ["label"], depth 2) and Biome noLabelWithoutControl (labelComponents/inputComponents supported) run with defaults. Measured: <Label>Name</Label> is reported by ESLint only. astro/jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control also runs without options. f7025b12 claims 'decisions matching the ESLint presets'; the parity script cannot see option-only gaps (L391-396).

inconsistencies.topic: control-has-associated-label behaves differently with no options
inconsistencies.detail: Both ESLint and Oxlint enable it with no options, but defaults differ: Oxlint ignores input/textarea/audio/... and listbox/menu/grid/... roles; eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y ignores only 'link'. Measured: <input type="text" /> and <div role="listbox" tabIndex={0} /> fail in ESLint and pass in Oxlint. jsx-a11y's recommended config ships the rule off.
AGENTS.md says Oxlint is the benchmark, but the Oxlint test (oxlint-config.test.ts L1312-1324) says the off decision comes from 'config/eslint/react/rules — keep in sync.'

inconsistencies.topic: Docs say core enables a11y rules
inconsistencies.detail: configuration.mdx L34 says that with the `core` preset 'ARIA attributes, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, and other a11y rules are enabled by default.' True for Biome core; Oxlint core has no a11y rule (jsx-a11y is only in the react preset, github/a11y-* only in opt-in js-plugins); ESLint core has only five github/a11y-* rules and four sonarjs table/alt rules, with jsx-a11y in the react preset.

inconsistencies.topic: Template places a11y under React & JSX
inconsistencies.detail: rules.ts L58-63 puts the a11y bullet under '### React & JSX', while Biome core applies its a11y group to every project (including HTML/Vue/Svelte/Astro templates in the framework presets). The ESLint vue and angular presets ship no a11y plugin (no eslint-plugin-vuejs-accessibility, no @angular-eslint/template), and Oxlint has no a11y rules outside react.

inconsistencies.detail: 'Use proper heading hierarchy' (18ed1f31) is not enforced by any enabled rule; react-doctor/no-skipped-heading-level exists but is off in both ESLint and Oxlint (recommended:false). The other four sub-bullets map to enabled rules.

AGENTS.md says rules.ts and skills/ultracite/references/code-standards.md must change together. The skill's 'When Your Linter Can't Help' item is '5. User experience' without 'Accessibility, performance, and usability considerations' (fb8b5392).

ESLint react enables react-doctor html-label-has-single-control, no-uninformative-aria-label, role-button-requires-complete-keyboard-activation, no-multiple-unlabeled-navigation-landmarks; Oxlint js-plugins does not, though oxlint-plugin-react-doctor 0.9.16 implements them. Acknowledged in compare-rule-parity.ts L242-243.
ESLint applies jsx-a11y only to **/*.jsx and **/*.tsx (react/eslint.config.mjs); the Oxlint react preset has no file restriction, so JSX in .js files gets a11y checks only from Oxlint and Biome.

c92a9d2e README: 'to enable the `noAutofocus` rule' over a snippet that sets it "off"; 8cab3bcc docs: 'to disable the `noAutofocus` rule' though the preset already disabled it. Replaced by a useButtonType example in 6d490cc0 (2026-07-04).

coverage.astro A11y 'available: 39'; the Biome 2.5.15 schema's A11y group has 38 rules plus a `preset` key. Every group in that component is one higher than its rule count (catalogSize 565 = 557 rules + 8 presets), so the counts look like they include `preset`. Docs only; raise, not fixed.

notes: No question about no-autofocus has a recorded rationale in any linter. It was off from the first ESLint commit (e403fb15, 2022-03-18) and carried forward: to Biome by `biome migrate` (cdef1f91, PR #140), to Oxlint in V7 (c4a205f8), and locked to ESLint by a test (f7025b12). It was never on under jsx-a11y/ or Biome. If the post needs the reason, ask Hayden.
The label-has-associated-control options have only a commit subject as rationale (7a6aa5fc). Why depth 3, and why the options never reached Oxlint or Biome, was not recorded.

Effective a11y coverage in Oxlint was thin from 2026-04-13 (a63d9c57) to 2026-07-04 (f7025b12): the f7025b12 changeset says most a11y rules 'silently never ran'. Whether V7's core categories reached jsx-a11y rules between 2025-12-28 and 2026-04-13 was not tested.

From 2022-03-18 to 2023-06-08 the ESLint list omitted jsx-a11y/control-has-associated-label and jsx-a11y/lang (both existed in 6.5.1); c52fef07 turned them on by switching to 'every non-deprecated rule'. No reason for the omission was recorded.

5838b11c (2026-09-28, 'Fix homepage accessibility issues') fixed by hand issues on the repo's own Astro site (aria-selected on buttons, 22 extra tab stops on non-interactive spans, unnamed icons, an untitled iframe). The repo lints itself with Oxlint, whose astro preset has no rules; whether any shipped rule would have caught these was not tested.

Ultracite's own docs code used `autoFocus` on a textarea while the rule was off (6c27c6e9, 2025-10-20; removed with the Mintlify migration 80539875). Only an observation; nothing links it to the decision.
Commit e6cf2627 (refs/codex/snapshots) and 2a1d79c7 (bun-provider branch, draft PR #850) are not on main and were excluded.
